scope: Bounded isolated 2D per-unit-depth coupled incompressible finite-volume reference; no production integration/history/settings changes. No GPU benchmark until all declared coupled gates pass.

model.meaning: Idealised inviscid two-phase Euler; short smooth gravity-dominated tests, not viscous settling, real capillary coalescence or 3D qualification. Finite gas density is a model, not a solver density floor.
model.geometry: Uniform Cartesian mesh; periodic x; periodic y for closed-material controls or impermeable free-slip flat bed and rigid gas lid. Oblique solid geometry outside scope.
model.transport: At most2 interface methods: monotone algebraic MUSCL control and geometric piecewise-linear VOF with split compression accounting. Staggered momentum uses the same phase-derived mass fluxes. No particles.
model.pressure: Same compatible incidence/divergence/mass-adjoint gradient, face density from consistent staggered mass. Uniform rectangular direct solve only in valid constant-density controls. Variable coefficients use small sparse direct reference; no multigrid implementation unless physical evidence and size require it.
model.time: One baseline explicit Euler coupling, and one midpoint coupling if needed to isolate temporal splitting error. No arbitrary damping.

criteria.convergence: At least3 spatial levels; two finest must pass references or successive-refinement errors and decrease. At least3 timesteps at fixed geometry. Preserve coarse failures. Reference waves derived from finite-depth two-fluid linear theory with rigid lid; keep analytical linearisation error far below1% using amplitude/H<=1e-3.

sequence: Conservative translation, shear, constant/affine velocity and pressure-work ledgers
Hydrostatic gas/liquid equilibrium, fractional material interfaces
Small-amplitude two-layer gravity waves, independent dispersion/eigenfields
Symmetric controlled liquid-blob approach/collision: mass, momentum, symmetry, kinetic/potential energy and convergence. No exact post-contact shape claim.

bounds.spatial_levels: Primary Nx32,64,128 with rectangular aspect matching physical geometry. One finer diagnostic only if it resolves a specific uncertainty; not endless tuning.
bounds.time_refinement: CFL-like dt set prospectively for each manufactured/reference duration; hold physical geometry fixed.
bounds.stop: Reject a coupling on fundamental invariant failure; resolution errors require convergence evidence, not hidden smoothing/damping. If complete gates fail, no GPU throughput benchmark or inherited pressure-only performance claim.
bounds.raw: Every accepted coupled state and per-stage conservation/energy ledger; failed prefix, input, sources, solver diagnostics and raw reference comparisons retained. Checksum and fsync local plus independent primary-home copy.

performance_if_admitted: Primary RTX4070 complete coupled step per simulated second, all transport/interface/pressure/coupling included. Separate planning, output and audits. Physics-matched workload, three alternating trials and timestep sensitivity. No projection presented as a measurement.
